description: Register a new Ubriot release app (repo, branch, Expo project root within the repo, iOS/Android bundle identifiers). Returns the new app's ID and slug. Use before triggering the first build of a brand-new app.

app_store_connect_app_id.description: App Store Connect app id for TestFlight (optional)

auto_submit_testflight.description: Auto-submit successful iOS builds to TestFlight

expo_project_root.description: Path to the Expo app within the repo, e.g. products/evenly/app (defaults to .)

repo_url.description: Git repository URL to build from

name: ubriot_create_app
